images.prompt:
Design a complete, polished Instagram festival poster for an orthopaedic clinic, for DIWALI. Image 1 is our previous Navratri poster: match its overall layout, quality, typography style and level of polish exactly, but make it about Diwali (diyas, rangoli, marigolds, warm golden lights) instead of Navratri, with no goddess. Images 2 and 3 are the doctor: keep his face, beard, hair and skin tone identical, standing at left in a white doctor's coat over a light blue shirt with arms crossed. The coat pocket reads exactly 'Dr. Manoj Yadav' and below it 'Orthopaedic Surgeon'. Image 4 is the clinic logo: reproduce it faithfully at top left. Colour palette: deep green #1F5A48 / brand green #62AA94, navy #0D2C5C, cream and warm gold.

Use EXACTLY this text, spelled exactly as written, and no other text:
Top right of logo, title: 'BONES AND JOINTS CLINIC'
Under title, small caps line: 'COMPLETE ORTHOPAEDIC CARE • VASAI – VIRAR'
Main greeting, large elegant: 'Happy Diwali'
Under it in Marathi (Devanagari): 'दीपावलीच्या हार्दिक शुभेच्छा!'
Message in serif: 'May the festival of lights bring good health, strong bones and joy to you and your family.'
Ribbon heading: 'SPECIALISED ORTHOPAEDIC CARE'
Six service icons with labels: 'Knee & Hip Replacement', 'Arthroscopy', 'Sports & Ligament Injuries', 'Fracture Care', 'Spine & Back Care', 'Childhood Bone & Joint Problems'
Left address block: 'NALLASOPARA WEST' / 'Shop No. 14, Veena Apartment,' / 'Opposite Patil Hospital, S.T. Stand Road,' / 'Nallasopara West – 401203' / phone '+91 87665 22099'
Right address block: 'VIRAR EAST' / 'Shop No. 7, Damodar Tower,' / 'Opposite Parimal Hospital, Manvel Pada Road,' / 'Virar East – 401305' / phone '+91 92702 84859'
Footer bar: 'www.bonesnjointsclinic.com' on the left.
At the RIGHT end of the footer bar, leave a plain, completely empty white rounded square about 14% of the poster width (for a QR code to be added later), with the small label 'Scan to save contact' just above it. Do not draw any QR code or pattern inside the square.

Everything must look like one coherent, professionally designed poster, with consistent fonts, alignment and spacing.

Design a complete, premium Instagram Diwali greeting poster for an orthopaedic clinic in a cleaner, more modern style than image 1 (our earlier Navratri poster), keeping the same professional quality and information layout. Night-time Diwali mood: a softly glowing deep navy and green background with golden diya lights, a few marigolds and a subtle rangoli at the bottom edge. The doctor from images 2 and 3 stands on the right, waist up, white coat over a light blue shirt, warm smile, keeping his face, beard, hair and skin tone identical. The coat pocket reads exactly 'Dr. Manoj Yadav' / 'Orthopaedic Surgeon'. Reproduce the clinic logo from image 4 faithfully at top left.

Use EXACTLY this text, spelled exactly as written, and no other text:
'BONES AND JOINTS CLINIC' (title beside the logo)
'COMPLETE ORTHOPAEDIC CARE' (small line under title)
'Happy Diwali' (large, elegant gold lettering on the left)
'दीपावलीच्या हार्दिक शुभेच्छा!' (Marathi, under the greeting)
'Wishing you light, good health and strong bones.' (one line)
Bottom info panel in two columns:
'NALLASOPARA WEST' / 'Opp. Patil Hospital, S.T. Stand Road' / '+91 87665 22099'
'VIRAR EAST' / 'Opp. Parimal Hospital, Manvel Pada Road' / '+91 92702 84859'
Footer: 'www.bonesnjointsclinic.com'
In the bottom-right corner, leave a plain, completely empty white rounded square about 14% of the poster width for a QR code to be added later, with the tiny label 'Scan to save contact' above it. Do not draw any QR pattern in it.

One coherent, professionally designed poster with consistent typography and spacing.
